name: projects
title: Projects
description: Projects, tasks and to-dos, shared by you and your dots

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Every project with its sections, in order

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Add a section at the end of a project

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks without their spec, filtered. assignee: "me" (you), "person", or a dot's id or name. view: "my_tasks" (the person's tasks and unassigned to-dos) or "assigned_to_dots". due_before: YYYY-MM-DD. At most limit tasks (100 by default), and for you at most about 28 KB of them; more: true means there are more. With many tasks, filter by status (and project_id or assignee) rather than reading them all.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: A task with its spec, subtasks and recent activity (the last 20 rows, or the last activity rows); a spec change in the activity shows the first 200 characters of the spec before and after

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Add a task: in a project's section, in a project, or with neither as a to-do. assignee: "me" (you), "person", a dot's id or name, or null. due_on: YYYY-MM-DD or null. A dot cannot create a task as done.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Change a task's fields; each change shows in its Activity. status: to_do, in_progress, in_review or done (only the person marks a task done: set in_review when your work is finished). assignee: "me" (you), "person", a dot's id or name, or null. due_on: YYYY-MM-DD or null. section_id: a section of any project (the task moves to that project), or null.

tools.name: add_subtask
tools.description: Add a subtask at the end of a task's checklist

tools.name: set_subtask
tools.description: Check or uncheck a subtask, or rename it

tools.name: comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task's Activity: progress, a question, what you found

tools.name: list_dots
tools.description: The dots a task can be assigned to: those that use Projects

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: Move a task to another section (section_id, or null for none) and before another task of that list (before_id, or null for the end)

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo a change in a task's Activity, while its field still holds what the change set. A dot undoes only dots' changes.
